text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Phew!
Today's training was splendid as well!
choice_data_list: You worked especially hard today, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Isn't that over there Yaeno—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No Reason-san. Are you done with training?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that is so!
Looks like you're done for the day as well!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right.
We just finished up...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What's the matter with you!
You've got that look in your eye that says you haven't run enough."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Thou art truly like one who lives by the way of the warrior!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nothing gets past you, does it, No Reason-san?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As you say, my mind is elsewhere right now. It seems my heart is still lingering on the training grounds.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Then let us settle this one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking I hadn't run enough.
Having an opponent makes it all the more worthwhile!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Well then, I'm off to cause some more havoc!
choice_data_list: There might indeed be a lot to gain by competing against each other.
There are ways to blow off steam without running!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Right!?
There are surely things that can only be gained
by running alongside Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho!? What's this, what's this?
What kind of clever scheme do you have up your sleeve?
choice_data_list: Let's get some good sleep at the dorm!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What a simple plan!
Relieving stress through sleep!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Still, come to think of it, this could be seen as a good way to avoid needless fatigue...
Quite profound...
